abstract: A discrete choice experiment was conducted to elicit consumer preferences for a sustainable beef product from cattle fed a seaweed‐supplemented diet. Additionally, two types of information treatments were tested to determine the more effective method of conveying environmental information. Findings indicate that consumers tend to discount such novel beef. However, while both information treatments significantly increased willingness to pay, the layperson's language proved significantly more effective and independent of consumers' educational background. These results imply that straightforward communication can enhance consumer acceptance of innovative, sustainable products. Policymakers and the beef industry should prioritize the use of plain language to promote environmentally friendly meat products.
abstract_zh: 本研究开展了一项离散选择实验，以考察消费者对采用海藻补充饲料喂养的肉牛所生产的可持续牛肉产品的偏好。此外，研究还测试了两种信息处理方式，以确定传递环境信息的更有效方法。研究结果表明，消费者倾向于对这类新型牛肉产品给予折价。然而，尽管两种信息处理方式均显著提高了支付意愿，但通俗语言表述被证明显著更为有效，且不受消费者教育背景的影响。这些结果意味着，直白的沟通方式能够提升消费者对创新、可持续产品的接受度。政策制定者和牛肉行业应优先使用通俗语言来推广环境友好型肉制品。
title: Impact of Layperson and Scientific Messaging on Sustainable Beef From Seaweed‐Fed Cattle
title_zh: 外行与科学信息传递对海藻饲喂牛可持续牛肉的影响

abstract: The nations of the United Kingdom have set ambitious policy targets for land-based activities and outputs including around food production, climate change and biodiversity. As land area is constrained these targets risk not being met without coordinated policy. Maximising the public and private benefits from the land requires understanding the trade-offs and synergies between different activities, and the comparative advantage of different areas in producing different outputs. The “three-compartment model” has emerged as a conceptual tool to guide land use policy where land can be broadly classified as being managed (i) primarily for food; (ii) for a mixture of food and public goods and (iii) for non-agricultural outputs, including nature. It was adopted by England’s National Food Strategy (2021). The paper reviews two classes of critical response to the three-compartment model: (i) concerns from conventional agriculture, and (ii) worries by proponents of low-input agriculture. It attempts to understand the basis of the criticisms and how they might be addressed. Given the urgency with which land use is required to meet policy targets the paper concludes by arguing that a properly articulated three-compartment model can be a means of bringing together different stakeholders to act in the immediate future.
abstract_zh: 英国各构成国已为土地相关活动及其产出设定了雄心勃勃的政策目标，涵盖粮食生产、气候变化和生物多样性等方面。由于土地面积有限，若缺乏协调一致的政策，这些目标恐难以实现。要最大化土地带来的公共和私人效益，就需要理解不同活动之间的权衡与协同关系，以及不同区域在生产不同产出方面的比较优势。“三分区模型”已成为指导土地利用政策的概念性工具，该模型将土地大致归类为：(i) 主要用于粮食生产；(ii) 用于粮食与公共产品的混合用途；(iii) 用于非农业产出，包括自然保护。英格兰的《国家粮食战略》（2021年）采纳了该模型。本文梳理了对三分区模型的两类批评性回应：(i) 传统农业的关切，以及(ii) 低投入农业支持者的担忧。文章试图理解这些批评的依据以及可能的应对方式。鉴于实现政策目标对土地利用的紧迫要求，本文最后指出，一个表述得当的三分区模型可以成为凝聚不同利益相关方、在近期共同行动的手段。
title: The land use challenge in the United Kingdom: Finding space for food production and biodiversity
title_zh: 英国土地利用的挑战：为粮食生产与生物多样性寻找空间

abstract: We develop and test a model of fiscal accountability in which parties compete over integrated fiscal platforms comprising taxes, public-good provision, and political rents. The theory shows how power-sharing institutions discipline rent extraction: greater disproportionality in the vote-to-power mapping increases the political cost of marginal vote losses and, along the interior equilibrium, reduces rents, raises public-good provision, and improves voter welfare. We test these predictions in a laboratory election environment that observes both candidate platform choices and voter behavior. The evidence supports the central institutional mechanism. The disproportional rule reduces proposed rents, shifts platforms toward public-good provision, and increases aggregate voter welfare. Accountability, however, remains incomplete. Voters respond to fiscal performance, but less than the rational (automated) benchmark; partisan bias dampens policy responsiveness among opposing voters; and a public-good “gambit” makes rents less electorally costly when bundled with public-good gains.
abstract_zh: 我们构建并检验了一个财政问责模型，其中政党围绕由税收、公共品供给和政治租金构成的综合财政平台展开竞争。该理论揭示了权力分享制度如何约束租金抽取：选举得票与政治权力映射中比例失调程度越高，边际选票损失的政治成本就越大，并且在内部均衡处，这会降低租金、提高公共品供给并改善选民福利。我们在一个实验室选举环境中检验了这些预测，该环境同时观察候选人的平台选择与选民行为。证据支持核心的制度机制。比例失调规则降低了所提出的租金，使平台向公共品供给倾斜，并提高了选民的总福利。然而，问责仍然不完整。选民会对财政绩效作出反应，但反应弱于理性（自动化）基准；党派偏见削弱了对立选民的政策响应性；而公共品的“策略性让步”使得当租金与公共品收益捆绑时，其选举成本降低。
title: Fiscal accountability: Institutional discipline and behavioral frictions
title_zh: 财政问责：制度约束与行为摩擦

abstract: Why do women’s labour earnings drop upon motherhood? We shed new light on this question by analysing the changes in job search behaviour associated with motherhood. We exploit data on the job applications sent on a popular online platform linked with administrative registers for 350,000 involuntarily unemployed workers in France. After losing their job, mothers have a 11.7% lower probability to find a job than similar women without children and send 12.2% fewer job applications. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we analyse the timing of job applications. Unlike other women, mothers’ rate of applications decreases by about 20.5% in the hours when there is no school. Moreover, the French reform that introduced school on Wednesday in 2014 led mothers to send more applications on Wednesdays. Our results highlight that childcare creates constraints on the timing of job search activities for mothers. We finally provide suggestive evidence that these constraints decrease their return-to-search, and thereby contribute to their lower application and job finding rates.
abstract_zh: 为什么女性在成为母亲后劳动收入会下降？我们通过分析与母职相关的求职行为变化，为这一问题提供了新的见解。我们利用一个广受欢迎的在线平台上发送的求职申请数据，并将其与法国35万名非自愿失业工人的行政登记数据相链接。在失去工作后，母亲找到工作的概率比没有孩子的类似女性低11.7%，发送的求职申请少12.2%。为探究其 underlying 机制，我们分析了求职申请的时间分布。与其他女性不同，母亲在无学校时段内的申请率下降约20.5%。此外，法国2014年引入周三上课的改革促使母亲在周三发送更多申请。我们的结果强调，育儿对母亲的求职活动时间形成了约束。我们最后提供了 suggestive 证据，表明这些约束降低了她们的求职回报，进而导致其较低的申请率和就业找到率。
title: Motherhood and Constraints during Job Search
title_zh: 求职过程中的母职与限制

abstract: Les programmes de santé doivent respecter des seuils de rentabilité, mais les services sociaux ne sont soumis à aucun critère de ce type. Cet article s'appuie sur la réforme espagnole de 2007 relative aux soins de longue durée pour montrer que l'accès à des aides financières et à une aide à domicile financée par les pouvoirs publics a amélioré la satisfaction de vie, réduit la solitude et augmenté la survie, pour un coût par année de vie ajustée en fonction de la qualité bien inférieur aux seuils appliqués aux programmes de santé. Ces résultats suggèrent qu’une partie d’un service national de prise en charge pourrait être financée en remplaçant des programmes de santé moins rentables par des services sociaux.
abstract_zh: 卫生项目必须遵守成本效益阈值，而社会服务则不受此类标准的约束。本文基于西班牙2007年长期护理改革，表明获得财政援助和由政府资助的居家护理提高了生活满意度、减少了孤独感并提高了生存率，其每质量调整生命年的成本远低于卫生项目所适用的阈值。这些结果表明，国家护理服务体系的一部分可以通过用社会服务替代成本效益较低的卫生项目来获得资金支持。
authors: Joan Costa-i-Font, Sergi Jiménez-Martín, Cristina Vilaplana Prieto
title: Les services sociaux destinés aux adultes peuvent offrir un meilleur rapport qualité-prix que les soins de santé que nous finançons déjà
title_zh: 面向成年人的社会服务可能比我们目前资助的医疗保健更具成本效益

abstract: This study examines the relationship between well-being and temperature across 167 countries from 1990 to 2019, employing the Social Progress Index (SPI) as a measure of well-being and social progress. Using a fixed-effects panel data framework, I study temperature impacts on social progress by modelling local and global weather anomalies simultaneously, capturing both within-country temporal and global climate variation. First, a statistically significant negative relationship exists between annual temperature anomalies and well-being, with a 1 °C global (local) mean temperature deviation leading to a 0.8068 (0.0929) point decline, respectively. Second, annual precipitation anomalies have no statistically significant effect on the SPI. Third, an increase in temperature anomaly has a more adverse impact in winter and spring than in other seasons. Fourth, poorer regions, hotter climates,global south, and countries with weak institutions are disproportionately affected by temperature deviations. Fifth, the impact of temperature on well-being persists over the medium term, most clearly through the global temperature anomalies.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1990年至2019年间167个国家幸福感与温度之间的关系，采用社会进步指数（SPI）作为幸福感和社会进步的衡量指标。运用固定效应面板数据框架，我通过同时建模局部和全球天气异常来研究温度对社会进步的影响，捕捉国内时间变化和全球气候变异。第一，年度温度异常与幸福感之间存在统计上显著的负相关关系，全球（局部）平均温度偏差1°C分别导致0.8068（0.0929）点的下降。第二，年度降水异常对SPI没有统计上显著的影响。第三，温度异常的上升在冬季和春季的不利影响大于其他季节。第四，较贫困地区、较热气候、全球南方以及制度薄弱的国家受温度偏差的影响不成比例地更大。第五，温度对幸福感的影响在中期持续存在，最明显地通过全球温度异常体现。
title: Beyond GDP: Quantifying heterogeneous impact of climate change on social progress
title_zh: 超越GDP：量化气候变化对社会进步的异质性影响

abstract: Employees may exercise stock options early to diversify, to fund consumption, or for behavioral reasons. While prior research emphasizes diversification, limited evidence distinguishes these motives. Using data for 3,500 employees across five companies, we show that home price changes, our proxy for exogenous changes in outside wealth, are positively associated with option exercises, consistent with consumption motives but not diversification or behavioral reasons. We estimate that annual option exercises increase by $0.17 per dollar of home price increase. Additional findings are inconsistent with diversification motives: exercise is more likely following grants of restricted stock but not options, employees often exercise all available options at once, and the risk aversion required to justify early exercise is implausibly large. We also present survey evidence from 1,674 stock-option plan participants suggesting that consumption is the primary motive for option exercises. Collectively, our findings suggest that prior research overstates the importance of diversification motives.
abstract_zh: 员工可能出于分散风险、为消费融资或行为方面的原因而提前行使股票期权。尽管已有研究强调分散化动机，但区分这些动机的证据仍然有限。我们利用五家公司3500名员工的数据表明，房价变化——我们将其作为外部财富外生变化的代理变量——与期权行使呈正相关，这与消费动机一致，而与分散化或行为方面的原因不一致。我们估计，房价每上涨1美元，年度期权行使额增加0.17美元。其他发现与分散化动机不一致：在授予限制性股票而非期权之后，员工更可能行使期权；员工往往一次性行使所有可行权的期权；而为证明提前行使的合理性所需的风险厌恶程度大得不合情理。我们还提供了来自1674名股票期权计划参与者的调查证据，表明消费是期权行使的主要动机。总体而言，我们的发现表明，已有研究高估了分散化动机的重要性。
title: Diversification versus Consumption Motives for Early Exercise of Employee Stock Options
title_zh: 多元化与消费动机对员工股票期权提前行权的比较

abstract: This paper examines the conditions under which the profitability of banking capital can exceed that of industrial capital. In a benchmark scenario where banks extend credit only to industrial firms, the industrial sector dominates in terms of return on equity unless two conditions are jointly satisfied: financial intermediation costs must be sufficiently low, and the industrial sector’s leverage must be sufficiently high. The analysis is then extended to a more realistic environment in which banks also lend to households, who finance large expenditures—such as housing, vehicles, and education—through bank credit. In this setting, the return on bank equity can exceed that of industrial capital whenever the flow of household interest payments is sufficiently large, even if bank funding costs remain high or industrial leverage is modest. Thus, household debt service can constitute an additional and potentially important source of bank profitability relative to the industrial sector. Using U.S. quarterly data for 1984–2020, an ARDL bounds test provides empirical support for cointegration between the bank–industry profitability differential and aggregate household debt-service payments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察银行资本利润率超过产业资本利润率的条件。在银行仅向产业企业发放信贷的基准情形中，除非两个条件同时满足，否则产业部门在净资产收益率上占优：金融中介成本必须足够低，且产业部门杠杆率必须足够高。随后，分析被扩展到一个更现实的环境，其中银行也向家庭放贷，家庭通过银行信贷为住房、汽车和教育等大额支出融资。在这一情形下，只要家庭利息支付流足够大，即使银行融资成本仍然较高或产业杠杆率适中，银行净资产收益率也可能超过产业资本收益率。因此，相对于产业部门，家庭偿债可以构成银行盈利能力的额外且可能重要的来源。使用1984—2020年美国季度数据，ARDL边界检验为银行—产业利润率差与家庭偿债总支付之间的协整关系提供了经验支持。
title: The profitability of bank capital and household debt
title_zh: 银行资本与家庭债务的盈利能力

abstract: A laboratory experiment finds that teams acting as a decision‐making unit through communication behave more efficiently than individuals. Decision‐making units vote on formal and informal sanctions in a repeated public goods dilemma. When a formal scheme is selected, teams vote for deterrent sanction rates more frequently than individuals. When an informal scheme is selected, teams inflict costly punishment more frequently toward low contributors. As such, teams sustain cooperation more efficaciously than individuals. The results underscore the effectiveness of utilizing teams as a decision‐making unit in organizations in combating moral hazard, such as free riding.
abstract_zh: 一项实验室实验发现，通过沟通作为决策单元行事的团队比个体行为更有效率。在重复的公共物品困境中，决策单元对正式和非正式制裁进行投票。当选择正式方案时，团队比个体更频繁地投票支持具有威慑力的制裁率。当选择非正式方案时，团队更频繁地对低贡献者施加代价高昂的惩罚。因此，团队比个体更有效地维持合作。这些结果凸显了在组织中利用团队作为决策单元来应对道德风险（如搭便车）的有效性。
title: The individual‐team discontinuity effect on institutional choices: Experimental evidence in voluntary public goods provision
title_zh: 个体—团队不连续性对制度选择的影响：自愿公共物品供给中的实验证据

abstract: This paper evaluates income tax schedules by their ability to reduce absolute inequality in a dynamic setting. Classical static absolute-equalization criteria permit a broad class of nonlinear tax schedules, but they do not assess whether a tax system mitigates changes in inequality over time. We introduce Dynamic Absolute Equalization and show that a continuous tax schedule satisfies this criterion if and only if it is affine, with a marginal tax rate between zero and one and a nonpositive intercept. Dynamic equalization thus imposes a substantially sharper restriction than static absolute equalization.
abstract_zh: 本文在动态情境下，依据所得税税制减少绝对不平等的能力对其进行评估。经典的静态绝对均等化标准允许广泛类别的非线性税收制度，但这些标准并不评估税收体系是否缓解不平等随时间的变化。我们引入动态绝对均等化，并证明一个连续税收制度满足该标准当且仅当其为仿射的，边际税率介于零与一之间且截距非正。因此，动态均等化施加了比静态绝对均等化严格得多的限制。
title: On dynamic income taxation and absolute inequality
title_zh: 关于动态所得税与绝对不平等

abstract: Innovation booms are often fueled by easy financing, allowing new technology firms to pay high wages that attract skilled labor. Studying the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) boom in the late 1990s, we show that high-skill workers who joined the ICT sector during the boom experienced sizeable long-term earnings losses. These earnings patterns stem from accelerated skill obsolescence rather than worker selection or the subsequent bust in the ICT sector. Moreover, during the boom, financing disproportionately flowed to firms whose workers would later experience the largest productivity declines, amplifying the negative effect of labor reallocation on aggregate human capital accumulation.
abstract_zh: 创新热潮往往由宽松融资推动，使新技术企业能够支付高工资以吸引技术劳动力。通过研究20世纪90年代末的信息与通信技术（ICT）热潮，我们发现，在繁荣期加入ICT行业的高技能工人经历了可观的长期收入损失。这些收入模式源于技能加速过时，而非工人选择或随后ICT行业的衰退。此外，在繁荣期，融资不成比例地流向那些工人后来将经历最大生产率下降的企业，放大了劳动力重新配置对总体人力资本积累的负面影响。
title: Innovation booms, easy financing, and human capital accumulation
title_zh: 创新热潮、宽松融资与人力资本积累

abstract: Double-shift school systems assign some adolescents to early-morning and others to afternoon schooling, yet causal evidence on the consequences of such large timing differences remains limited. I study a selective public middle school in Argentina, where the outcome of a public lottery determines a 7:30 a.m. or 1:15 p.m. start time for up to three years. Unlike the relatively modest schedule changes studied in most prior work, the lottery shifts the school day by nearly six hours while holding curriculum, facilities, and school-day length fixed, identifying reduced-form effects of school timing. Afternoon schooling increases self-reported night sleep by nearly an hour and reduces the share sleeping at most seven hours by 34 percentage points from a 65% baseline. Boys also gain total daily sleep, whereas morning-shift girls offset their shorter nights with longer naps, leaving total daily sleep unchanged. These differences largely disappear before non-school days. Behavioral responses diverge sharply by gender: afternoon assignment reduces boys’ aggressive or delinquent behavior, especially vandalism, but increases girls’ substance use initiation. Together with changes in extracurricular and social activities, these contrasting responses caution against interpreting school timing through a single channel such as sleep. In double-shift systems, school timing is thus a behavioral design choice, not merely a capacity tool.
abstract_zh: 双班制学校体系将部分青少年安排在清晨上课，另一些安排在下午上课，然而关于如此大的时间差异所带来后果的因果证据仍然有限。我研究了阿根廷一所择优录取的公立初中，该校通过公开抽签的结果决定学生最长三年内是早上7：30还是下午1：15开始上课。与大多数先前研究中相对温和的作息变化不同，该抽签将近乎六小时的学校日程偏移，同时保持课程、设施和在校时长不变，从而识别出学校上课时间的简约式效应。下午上课使自我报告的夜间睡眠增加近一小时，并将睡眠至多七小时的比例从65%的基线降低34个百分点。男生还获得了每日总睡眠的增加，而早班女生则用更长的午睡来弥补较短的夜间睡眠，使每日总睡眠保持不变。这些差异在上学日之前基本消失。行为反应因性别而显著分化：被分配到下午上课减少了男生的攻击性或违法行为，尤其是破坏公物行为，但增加了女生的物质使用起始行为。结合课外活动和社会活动的变化，这些截然不同的反应提醒人们不要通过单一渠道（如睡眠）来解读学校上课时间。因此，在双班制体系中，学校上课时间是一种行为设计选择，而不仅仅是容量工具。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: School timing, sleep, and adolescent behavior: Evidence from lottery-assigned start times
title_zh: 学校作息时间、睡眠与青少年行为：基于抽签分配上课时间的证据

abstract: Nuclear power projects combine long construction periods, high capital intensity, contractual arrangements, and long-lived geopolitical relationships. This study compares the Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant in Türkiye and the El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant in Egypt to examine how financing architecture interacts with capital cost, ownership, debt exposure, operational control, and supplier dependence. The projects are treated as highly comparable rather than technically identical: both are four-unit Rosatom-supplied VVER-1200 projects with a gross capacity of 4800 MW, but Akkuyu uses the V-509 variant and El Dabaa the V-529 variant. The quantitative analysis uses a common net electricity-output basis of 35 TWh/yr. A standardized August-2026-real-USD scenario holds technical and operating assumptions constant and treats 8% for Akkuyu and 6% for El Dabaa as scenario discount rates rather than observed WACCs, yielding LCOEs of 6.30 and 5.37 cent/kWh. A second scenario makes public capital-cost proxies price-consistent: Akkuyu's USD 24.5 billion 2024 current-price estimate is normalized to USD 26.16 billion in August 2026 dollars, while El Dabaa's USD 28.75 billion agreement-era estimate is treated as a 2017-dollar proxy and normalized to USD 39.29 billion. The resulting LCOEs are 8.28 and 9.21 cent/kWh, respectively. This reversal shows that financing conditions cannot be interpreted independently of capital-cost level and price base. Akkuyu's tariff-LCOE comparison is reported only as an August 2026 base-date spread, while El Dabaa's sovereign loan is treated separately as a nominal debt-service obligation. Policy evaluation should jointly stress-test capital cost, discount rates, offtake terms, debt service, exchange-rate exposure, localization, and supplier resilience.
abstract_zh: 核电项目兼具建设周期长、资本密集度高、合同安排复杂以及地缘政治关系持久等特点。本研究比较土耳其阿库尤核电站与埃及埃尔达巴核电站，考察融资架构如何与资本成本、所有权、债务敞口、运营控制及供应商依赖相互作用。两个项目被视为高度可比而非技术完全相同：二者均为俄罗斯国家原子能公司供应的四机组VVER-1200项目，总装机容量4800 MW，但阿库尤采用V-509型，埃尔达巴采用V-529型。定量分析采用35 TWh/年的统一净发电量基准。标准化2026年8月实际美元情景保持技术与运行假设不变，并将阿库尤8%和埃尔达巴6%视为情景贴现率而非观测到的加权平均资本成本，得出平准化度电成本分别为6.30和5.37美分/千瓦时。第二情景使公共资本成本代理值价格一致：阿库尤245亿美元2024年现价估算值归一化为2026年8月美元的261.6亿美元，而埃尔达巴287.5亿美元协议期估算值被视为2017年美元代理值并归一化为392.9亿美元。由此得出的平准化度电成本分别为8.28和9.21美分/千瓦时。这一反转表明，融资条件不能脱离资本成本水平和价格基准来解读。阿库尤的电价与平准化度电成本比较仅作为2026年8月基准日的价差报告，而埃尔达巴的主权贷款则单独作为名义偿债义务处理。政策评估应联合对资本成本、贴现率、承购条款、偿债、汇率敞口、本地化及供应商韧性进行压力测试。
title: Financing models, energy diplomacy, and strategic dependency in nuclear power projects: A comparative analysis of Akkuyu and El Dabaa nuclear power plants
title_zh: 融资模式、能源外交与核电项目的战略依赖：阿库尤与达巴核电站的比较分析

abstract: We study the impact of a financial education program on portfolio choices in a setting that allows us to examine both participation decisions and differences in program benefits across individuals. We directly elicit willingness to pay for financial education and show that individuals with higher financial literacy, greater confidence in applying new knowledge, and higher expected returns are willing to pay more. Using incentivized portfolio allocation tasks, we develop outcome measures tailored to individual risk preferences and show that financial education improves decision quality along these dimensions. The program increases the share of participants who experience an improvement by 20 percentage points, corresponding to average gains of 3.2 percentage points of initial wealth. Individuals with the highest willingness to participate benefit disproportionately from the program, with important implications for the design and evaluation of financial education initiatives. By isolating a specific investment skill in a setting with voluntary participation, our design sheds light on how selection into financial education shapes measured program effects and informs the assessment of broader workplace and public training programs. This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: The authors thank the Pension Research Council of Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, as well as the Retirement and Savings Institute at HEC Montréal, for generous research funding. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08268 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项金融教育项目对投资组合选择的影响，该研究背景使我们能够同时考察参与决策以及项目收益在不同个体之间的差异。我们直接引出个体对金融教育的支付意愿，并表明，金融素养更高、对运用新知识更有信心以及预期回报更高的个体愿意支付更多。利用激励性投资组合配置任务，我们构建了针对个体风险偏好的结果指标，并表明金融教育在这些维度上改善了决策质量。该项目使经历改善的参与者比例提高了20个百分点，对应于初始财富平均增加3.2个百分点。参与意愿最高的个体从项目中获益不成比例地更大，这对金融教育举措的设计与评估具有重要启示。通过在一个自愿参与的环境中分离出一项特定投资技能，我们的设计揭示了进入金融教育的选择如何塑造所测得的项目效应，并为更广泛的工作场所和公共培训项目的评估提供信息。本文由Marie Claire Villeval（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：作者感谢宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院养老金研究委员会以及蒙特利尔高等商学院退休与储蓄研究所的慷慨研究资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08268获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Selection into Financial Education and Effects on Portfolio Choice
title_zh: 金融教育的选择性与对投资组合选择的影响

abstract: Data-extrapolation technologies enable progress by importing and applying empirical patterns from one domain to another. Their reliance on empirical patterns, however, is also their limitation: these tools can only be applied where data are abundant. Using the setting of structural biology, I investigate the impact of a data-extrapolation technology on innovation. I exploit the variation in prior data availability to compare areas in which the tool was usable to those in which it was not. I find that the tool increased the quantity of research in data-rich areas: the resulting output yielded limited biological insights but was methodologically rigorous and contributed to downstream research. This paper was accepted by Toby Stuart, entrepreneurship and innovation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04115 .
abstract_zh: 数据外推技术通过将某一领域的经验模式引入并应用于另一领域来推动进步。然而，其对经验模式的依赖也构成了局限：这些工具只能应用于数据丰富的领域。本文以结构生物学为背景，研究一种数据外推技术对创新的影响。我利用先前数据可得性的差异，将可使用该工具的区域与无法使用的区域进行比较。研究发现，该工具增加了数据丰富区域的研究数量：由此产生的成果所获得的生物学洞见有限，但在方法上严谨，并对下游研究有所贡献。本文由创业与创新领域编辑Toby Stuart接收。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04115获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Navigating the Rugged Data Landscape: The Impact of Data-Extrapolation Technologies on Knowledge Production
title_zh: 驾驭崎岖数据景观：数据外推技术对知识生产的影响

abstract: This paper examines the spending effects of a pandemic-related increase in Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits, one of the largest U.S. aid programs. In March 2020, SNAP recipients began receiving emergency allotments that raised their monthly grocery funds significantly. Using transaction data that record households’ goods purchases across various retailers, I show that emergency allotments increased monthly food-at-home spending by approximately $109 relative to eligible non-recipients, implying a marginal propensity to consume food of about 0.6. Recipients bought more items and traded up within categories toward higher quality, increasing purchases of meat, produce, and dairy that are otherwise less affordable, alongside beverages and snacks. Non-food spending rose little relative to the food response. A household survey corroborates the size and food concentration of the response. I also show that observing only the main retailer would capture around half of the food-at-home response.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了与疫情相关的补充营养援助计划（SNAP）福利增加所带来的支出效应，该计划是美国规模最大的援助项目之一。2020年3月，SNAP受助者开始领取紧急拨款，其每月食品杂货资金显著提高。利用记录家庭在各类零售商处商品购买情况的交易数据，我发现，相对于符合条件的非受助者，紧急拨款使每月家庭食品支出增加约109美元，意味着食品的边际消费倾向约为0.6。受助者购买了更多商品，并在品类内向上交易、转向更高质量的产品，增加了对原本较难负担的肉类、农产品和乳制品的购买，同时也增加了对饮料和零食的购买。非食品支出相对于食品支出的反应增幅很小。一项家庭调查证实了该反应规模及其集中于食品的特征。我还表明，仅观察主要零售商将只能捕捉到家庭食品支出反应的大约一半。
title: How were extra benefits spent?
title_zh: 额外收益是如何支出的？

abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium model to examine the optimal taxation of casino gaming in the presence of both positive and negative externalities associated with casino tourism. The framework integrates tourists' utility maximization, casinos' profit maximization, and policymakers' tax-setting decisions to determine the welfare-maximizing gaming tax. The model is sufficiently general to analyze casino-based tourism destinations with different institutional settings, including Las Vegas, Macau, and Osaka. The analysis shows that the optimal gaming tax decreases as casino entry is restricted and as positive spillovers from casino tourism to other local industries are increased. Conversely, higher social costs associated with casino gaming and greater gaming reliance on non-local tourist demand justify higher tax rates. The model provides a unified framework for evaluating the trade-offs between the economic benefits of casino tourism and its social costs, offering policy guidance for the efficient design of gaming taxation across tourism destinations.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，在赌场旅游同时带来正外部性和负外部性的情形下，考察赌场博彩的最优税收问题。该框架整合了游客的效用最大化、赌场的利润最大化以及政策制定者的税率设定决策，以确定使福利最大化的博彩税。该模型具有足够的一般性，可用于分析具有不同制度环境的赌场旅游目的地，包括拉斯维加斯、澳门和大阪。分析表明，随着赌场进入受到限制以及赌场旅游对其他本地产业的正向溢出效应增加，最优博彩税会下降。相反，与赌场博彩相关的社会成本越高，以及博彩对非本地游客需求的依赖程度越大，就越是支持较高的税率。该模型为评估赌场旅游的经济收益与其社会成本之间的权衡提供了一个统一框架，并为各旅游目的地高效设计博彩税收提供了政策指导。
title: Casino tourism, externalities, and optimal tax policy: A general equilibrium framework
title_zh: 赌场旅游、外部性与最优税收政策：一般均衡框架

abstract: This study examines the dynamic association between Chinese soybean demand and Brazilian land-use CO₂ emissions within the China–Brazil soybean trade–environment system. Using annual data for 1990–2024, the analysis combines Johansen cointegration and a vector error-correction model (VECM) with structural-break tests, forecast error variance decomposition (FEVD), Local Projections, and complementary robustness estimators. With an effective VECM sample of 32 observations, the Johansen results provide suggestive evidence consistent with one long-run equilibrium relationship rather than definitive finite-sample proof. The normalised vector implies a negative long-run equilibrium association between imports and emissions, but this coefficient is not causal and may reflect omitted policy shifts, yield growth, pasture–soy substitution, or other unobserved common influences. Evidence of short-run adjustment is strongest in the import equation. A post-2006 dummy is significant for imports but not for emissions, while the single-break Bai–Perron specification places a break in 2007; multiple-break dates are treated as exploratory because the series is short. FEVD and Local Projection estimates indicate that the measured Chinese-demand shock accounts for only a small and imprecisely estimated share of emissions variability. The results therefore support cautious conclusions about dynamic co-movement and adjustment, not the claim that higher Chinese imports reduce Brazilian emissions or that the model directly identifies the domestic determinants of the remaining emissions variation.

title: Global soybean markets and land-use emissions: Evidence from the China–Brazil soybean trade relationship
title_zh: 全球大豆市场与土地利用排放：来自中国—巴西大豆贸易关系的证据

abstract: This article proposes a theoretical framework that systematically integrates human rights and economic analysis, addressing gaps in previous attempts linking theory and policy. Rather than developing a new theoretical approach, we work within a standard social planner setting in which a social welfare function embeds both fiscal constraints and rights-based valuations, ensuring Pareto-efficient outcomes while guaranteeing minimum rights. Conceptually, we link principles, policy instruments, and outcomes, highlighting shared structures across disciplines and enabling policy design that balances efficiency, equity, and transparency. Empirically, a case study of universal social protection strategies in South Africa illustrates how economic, human rights, and integrated approaches produce different priorities: targeted basic income maximizes fiscal efficiency, the universal transfer maximizes equality and rights, and the integrated perspective favors the expansion of the existing system as the second-most rights-consistent and most cost efficient option. This fully integrated framework demonstrates that human rights economics is not a slogan, nor merely the economics of human rights or rights within economics, but a true integration of both—practically applicable, context-sensitive, and offering a pathway to fiscally sustainable, socially inclusive, and administratively feasible policies.
title: Human rights economics
title_zh: 人权经济学

abstract: Many tax regimes collect revenue to the extent that other governments do not. This paper develops a theory of how such cross-border minimum taxes should be designed, focusing on choices that affect avoidance of the regime. Making a minimum tax more difficult to avoid retains more firms within the regime but weakens competition among tax havens. Havens then raise their rates toward the minimum, reducing the top-up tax rate on shifted profit. As a result, an avoidable minimum tax can raise more revenue for the governments that impose it than an unavoidable one.
title: Optimal avoidability in cross-border minimum taxation
title_zh: 跨境最低税制中的最优规避性

abstract: Using novel data on loans to private equity (PE) sponsored firms, I examine whether direct lenders lend more like banks or arm’s-length investors. Financial covenants are ubiquitous in direct lending. Borrowers face more covenants, and violate them more often, than in bank loans. Direct lenders actively intervene post-violation, prompting firms to adopt conservative policies. During the COVID pandemic, they showed greater flexibility than banks, facilitated by more frequent PE sponsor equity injections. Prior sponsor relationships also predict higher credit supply for distressed borrowers. Overall, similar to banks, direct lenders engage in active monitoring and relationship lending.
title: Are direct lenders more like banks or arm’s-length investors?
title_zh: 直接贷款人更像银行还是保持距离的投资者？

abstract: The literature on optimal robot taxes generally uses model environments in which the displacement effect of automation does not lead to involuntary unemployment. In this paper, we study optimal taxation of robotic capital in an environment in which a binding minimum wage makes involuntary unemployment a long-run equilibrium outcome. In our dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous worker groups and income redistribution, the robot tax is a key determinant of the equilibrium shares of unemployed and minimum-wage workers. Our theoretical contribution is a closed-form solution for the lowest robot tax rate that blocks automation when the minimum wage is binding. We then calibrate the model to the United States and compute optimal robot taxes. Restricted to linear income taxation, the Ramsey planner sets a positive robot tax that distorts the assignment of tasks between workers and robotic capital to the point at which no task is automated. This second-best policy maximizes social welfare along a balanced growth path, at a small efficiency cost. The aggregate welfare gain relative to the status quo is an extensive-margin effect: the robot tax reallocates some of the unemployed workers from unemployment insurance into employment. We also show that an optimized income tax-subsidy system and an optimal robot tax are complements in creating welfare gains, whereas a non-binding minimum wage closes the reallocation channel by eliminating involuntary unemployment. Alternative calibrations do not alter these findings.
title: Optimal taxation of robotic capital with a binding minimum wage
title_zh: 最低工资约束下机器人资本的最优税收

abstract: Veteran-owned businesses receive preferential treatment in procurement by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, the largest civilian federal agency by procurement spending. We study a 2016 Supreme Court ruling that expanded the scope of these set-asides and estimate its effects on targeted firms and procurement outcomes. The ruling increased the share of purchase order contracts awarded to service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses. Gains accrued both to incumbent vendors and to first-time VA contractors, including firms that had previously registered but had not won federal awards. We find little evidence of changes in competition for awards, and no significant impact on contract execution performance. The results suggest that, in commercial procurement markets with relatively low barriers to entry, set-asides can expand access for targeted firms without detectable deterioration in government procurement outcomes.
title: The impact of preference programs in public procurement: Evidence from veteran set-asides
title_zh: 公共采购中优惠计划的影响：来自退伍军人预留项目的证据

abstract: How are public finances affected by climate-driven changes in wildfire risk? Using high-resolution meteorological forecasts, land use data, and US municipal bond spreads, we find that municipalities facing greater future wildfire exposure already incur higher borrowing costs: A one standard deviation increase in future wildfire risk is associated with a 7 (8) basis point rise in primary (secondary) market spreads—over 15% of the sample mean. Impacts appear larger in areas with higher minority populations and greater reliance on local revenue. Our study contributes to the broader literature by introducing a new approach to evaluating the capitalization of evolving physical climate risks.
title: Pricing climate risks: Evidence from wildfires and municipal bonds
title_zh: 气候风险定价：来自野火与市政债券的证据

abstract: This paper presents the first quantitative meta-analysis of the price elasticity of charitable giving under both rebate and matching schemes. We compile 137 elasticity estimates from 26 experimental papers and synthesize them using random-effects and multilevel models. Charitable giving is highly price-responsive: the pooled meta-analytic mean elasticity of total donations is −1.75, indicating that lowering the effective price of giving substantially increases charitable revenue. Although we observe considerable between-study heterogeneity and some evidence of publication bias, bias-adjusted estimates remain negative. Furthermore, elasticity is substantially more negative under matching (−2.44) than under rebate (−0.73), contradicting the theoretical prediction of equivalence but aligning with the original experimental findings in this literature. The rebate-matching difference is attenuated when moving from laboratory to field settings, although it persists.
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: Revisiting the price elasticity of charitable giving: Meta-analysis of tax incentives and matching donations
title_zh: 重新审视慈善捐赠的价格弹性：税收激励与配捐的元分析

abstract: Australia's East Coast Gas Market (ECGM) presents a policy paradox. Despite abundant gas reserves, households, businesses and industry continue to face high energy costs. These outcomes are commonly linked to the ECGM's integration with the international gas and oil markets. However, market structure alone does not explain why more structural forms of regulatory intervention remain politically constrained. This Perspective examines three recurring claims in Australia's gas policy debate: that increasing gas supply will lower domestic prices, that renewable energy is unreliable without continued reliance on gas, and that government intervention can correct problems within the gas market. Existing research has raised questions about each of these propositions. This paper, therefore, focuses on the political work they perform and argues that the claims circulate and reinforce one another by sustaining increased gas supply in response to affordability concerns, positioning gas as necessary for energy reliability, and providing reassurances that market problems can be managed through regulation. In doing so, they help to maintain an export-oriented gas market while narrowing the political space for structural intervention. The analysis highlights how market structure and political framing interact to constrain domestic energy governance and complicate energy transition in fossil-fuel-exporting economies.
title: The complexities and failures of Australia’s East Coast Gas Market
title_zh: 澳大利亚东海岸天然气市场的复杂性与失灵

abstract: We examine how strengthened anti-money laundering (AML) enforcement affects the U.S. banking sector. Heightened enforcement disproportionately raises compliance costs for small banks, especially in counties more exposed to money laundering. In these areas, small banks contract while large banks expand, increasing standardized, government-supported, and secured lending. While aggregate county-level credit does not decline differentially, local outcomes improve. Small establishments grow, non-tradable employment and wages rise, and real estate prices increase. The evidence is consistent with a reallocation mechanism in which AML enforcement shifts activity toward large banks, potentially improving intermediation quality through changes in the composition of local financial intermediation.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: The Weight of Compliance: Anti-Money Laundering Enforcement, Banking Sector Composition, and Lending
title_zh: 合规的重负：反洗钱执法、银行业结构与贷款

abstract: Buyer market power is a significant concern in many agricultural product procurement markets. Research almost exclusively treats such buyer power as a static element of agricultural market structure, despite evidence that buyer power varies across the marketing season for many commodities and locations. We study buyer power as a time-varying phenomenon and analyze the role of commodity storage in mitigating such power and increasing farmer incomes. Data-driven simulations show that strategic storage can generate significant farm income gains and risk reduction. Key factors determining welfare impacts are magnitudes and expected changes in buyer power and farmers’ storage efficiency and risk preferences.
title: Mitigating time-varying buyer power through farmer commodity storage
title_zh: 通过农户商品储存缓解时变买方势力

abstract: This paper investigates the causal effect of tax incentives on entrepreneurship. Using a staggered Value‐Added Tax (VAT) reform in China as an exogenous shock to conduct difference‐in‐differences estimation, we find that tax cuts have a considerable positive effect on local entrepreneurship. A plausible mechanism driving our findings is the ease of financial constraints. Our results are robust to a battery of endogeneity and robustness tests. We find that regions with high levels of institutional quality, trust, or a commercial culture undergo greater entrepreneurship after the VAT reform. Overall, this study provides a timely policy evaluation of the importance of tax incentives in promoting entrepreneurship in a typical emerging market.

title: Do Tax Incentives Enhance Entrepreneurship? Evidence from Value‐Added Tax Reform in China
title_zh: 税收激励能促进创业吗？来自中国增值税改革的证据

abstract: This paper studies the impact of interest rates on bank stability in a standard bank‐run model. Banks invest in long‐term assets, whose value decreases with interest rates, and set deposit rates to optimally insure depositors' liquidity risk. Liquidity‐risk insurance implies banks earn interest margins, which increase with interest rates. Hence, interest rates have two countervailing effects: they reduce the value of banks' long‐term assets while widening their margins. First, the paper characterizes the parametric condition under which an effect dominates. The condition implies interest‐rate risk is captured by banks' maturity mismatch adjusted for deposits' effective duration. Second, the paper solves for the interest‐rate level that tips banks into instability. Quantification points to the possibility of a negative effective maturity mismatch, making the tipping point a lower bound on interest rates.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Tipping Point: Interest Rates and Financial Stability
title_zh: 临界点：利率与金融稳定

abstract: Miscarriages occur in about 15% of recognised pregnancies and often cause grief and stress. We investigate the effect of a miscarriage on mental health care use, labour market and family outcomes of women and their partners using an event study framework applied to Dutch linked administrative data. After a miscarriage, women's use of mental health care temporarily increase compared to before the miscarriage, while their partner's use is unaffected. Furthermore, miscarriages affect labour market trajectories and reduce the probability of living together. Results are similar when comparing the effects of a miscarriage with the effects of having a child using a matched sample of women with a completed pregnancy.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: The Effect of a Miscarriage Compared to a Completed Pregnancy on Mental Health Care Use, Labour Market and Family Outcomes
title_zh: 流产与完成妊娠对心理健康服务使用、劳动力市场及家庭结局影响的比较

abstract: We study optimal management of the standard shallow lake model with special attention to the damage caused by the accumulated phosphorus in the water of the lake. The occurrence of a tipping point leads to a stronger increase in the damage after moving from the low-damage to the high-damage regime, because of the loss of ecosystem services. We modify the standard quadratic damage function by introducing a jump in marginal damage when moving from the low-damage to the high-damage regime. Connecting the lower and the higher marginal damage functions yields a continuous piecewise linear marginal damage function with a strong increase around the jump. In addition to the well-known oligotrophic and eutrophic steady states, we find that a third steady state can occur, separated by two Skiba points. This implies that a corridor or a basin of attraction arises between these two Skiba points where optimal management of the lake stabilizes the amount of phosphorus somewhere in the middle instead of either moving to the low-damage or to the high-damage regime, as is the result in the standard knife-edge case with one Skiba point.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Corridors in Shallow Lakes: The Case of Intermediate Pollution
title_zh: 浅水湖泊中的走廊：以中度污染为例

abstract: This paper argues that an individual region’s local public goods (LPGs) function as a double-edged sword for other regions: while they generate familiar positive spillovers, they simultaneously provoke regional concern over relative provision. Armed with this novel insight, we revisit the classical public-finance problem of LPG provision. We demonstrate that once LPGs are modeled as a double-edged sword, the direction of bias under decentralized versus centralized provision — whether undersupply or oversupply — is theoretically ambiguous. Crucially, this indeterminacy persists irrespective of whether the social planner accounts for regional concern over relative LPG provision. Beyond its theoretical implications, our framework provides a natural economic rationale for prominent real-world phenomena, specifically the widespread emergence and proliferation of gated communities.
title: Local public goods as a double-edged sword: familiar positive spillovers versus regional concern over relative provision
title_zh: 地方公共品作为双刃剑：熟悉的正面溢出效应与对相对供给的区域性关切

abstract: Cities in the United States dramatically expanded spending on public education after WWI, with the average urban school district increasing per pupil expenditures by over 70 percent by 1924. We provide the first evaluation of these unprecedented investments in public education using a new dataset and plausibly exogenous growth in school spending generated by anti-German sentiment. We find that school resources significantly increased educational attainment and wages later in life, particularly for less advantaged children. Increases in expenditures can explain about 40 percent of the sizable increase in educational attainment of cohorts born between 1895 and 1913. “Every great war in which the United States has played a part has been followed by educational developments of supreme national importance…Although the United States was engaged in the World War less than two years, the effects upon education resulting from this brief period of warfare will perhaps prove to be as far-reaching and as important as those growing out of any previous war…Undoubtedly the World War was the most important factor in awakening the American public to the inadequacy of its educational provisions and in arousing the States to vigorous efforts to improve educational conditions.” —Fletcher Harper Swift, Biennial Survey of Education 1920–1922, Volume 1, (1924, pp. 1–2).

abstract: Disruptive events are shocks that exceed a system's absorption capacity, temporarily or permanently disrupting technical, economic, and social routines. The 2022 energy crisis, triggered by the Russian invasion of Ukraine, subjected German households to skyrocketing energy prices in the presence of a surge in general inflation. We examine short-term adjustments across daily heating-related energy behavior, structural efficiency investment intentions, and multi-layered energy poverty by drawing on a survey study that was conducted among German households immediately before (Wave 1) and 10 months after (Wave 2) the Russian invasion of Ukraine. In contrast to standard economic expectations, we find minimal daily adjustments, and the perceived need to replace heating systems remained unchanged, though a qualitative shift toward renewables emerged. At the same time, while we do not find significant differences in expenditure-based energy poverty indicators, our consensual indicators reveal a significant increase in energy poverty rates across both waves. These findings are discussed in light of the specific institutional context, structural conditions, and time-specific peculiarities in Germany. Methodologically, we contribute to the energy poverty literature by demonstrating the operational advantages of subjective consensual indicators that overcome missing data and recall problems inherent in expenditure-based operationalizations. These findings highlight a critical trade-off in crisis-related energy policy. While broad-based financial relief reduces households' burden, it suppresses the price signals needed for behavioral or structural transformation. Effective policymaking must therefore combine immediate, targeted support for newly vulnerable groups with long-term structural measures to overcome entrenched domestic routines.
title: The impacts of the 2022 energy crisis on heating in German households - An empirical before-and-after examination of energy relevant concepts

abstract: Health programmes must clear cost-effectiveness thresholds, but social care faces no such test. This column uses Spain's 2007 long-term care reform to show that access to cash subsidies and publicly funded home help raised life satisfaction, reduced loneliness, and increased survival, at a cost per quality-adjusted life year well below the thresholds applied to health programmes. The results suggest that part of a national care service could be funded by replacing less cost-effective health programmes with social care.

abstract: Agreements between manufacturers and retailers can affect competition across brands and stores. This column documents retail price patterns in the US consumer battery industry and uses a model estimated from purchase data to explore two potential mechanisms: changes in downstream retail pricing and changes in upstream wholesale contracting. Counterfactual simulations illustrate how these mechanisms could jointly weaken competition. In the scenarios examined, the wholesale channel generates the larger consumer welfare loss. The findings highlight the importance of considering both channels when evaluating the potential effects of vertical agreements.
title: How agreements between suppliers and retailers can weaken competition

abstract: This paper studies patterns of functional change, defined as the change in the value chain functions performed within the manufacturing sector and related business services. To this end, a novel measure for the sophistication of value chain functions, labelled FUNCY, is developed, establishing a hierarchy of value chain functions. From the FUNCY measure functional productivities in the manufacturing sector are derived. A decomposition analysis, comprising developing and developed countries over time (2003-2022), suggests that, in contrast to the well-studied phenomenon of structural change, developing countries experienced modest functional upgrading over the past two decades. These group-level results mask large heterogeneity in the functional change component at the country level. Functional upgrading is driven by shifts from fabrication activities towards value chain functions with higher functional productivity such as business services. However, ‘large jumps’ to high-productivity functions such as ICT services or R&D activities are extremely rare.
title: Functional Upgrading in Global Value Chains

abstract: This paper studies how investor–State dispute settlement (ISDS) affects foreign direct investment (FDI) by examining countries’ membership in the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) and their first ISDS cases. Using a Poisson Pseudo–Maximum Likelihood (PPML) event-study estimator and newly compiled data, ICSID membership is shown to be associated with a substantial increase in bilateral investment, while a first ISDS case has no statistically significant effect. The results are not driven by simultaneous proliferation of bilateral investment treaties or other confounding events.

abstract: Shallow financial markets may act as an important structural constraint on a country’s ability to mobilize tax revenues. This paper explores this hypothesis in the context of Indonesia, a middle-income country with persistently low tax collections and low financial sector depth. At the macro level, relating cross-country financial development to new estimates of tax gaps, it finds that a 1 percent increase in private credit as a share of GDP could reduce the tax gap by approximately 0.2 percent. At the micro level, analysis of publicly listed Indonesian companies suggests that a one-decile increase in financial constraints is associated with a 0.18 percentage point drop in cash effective tax rates, indicating that financially constrained firms may be using tax planning as a liquidity tool. The results suggest that tax collections are positively associated with financial sector deepening.

abstract: The traditional approach to climate policy is to regulate the demand side, for example through an emissions fee. Supply-side regulation has received less attention. The two instruments are perfect substitutes in the first best but we show that they are complements in a second-best setting with free-riding incentives. Demand-side policies alone lower the market price of fossil fuels and raise the gains from trade for a country that defects. For a treaty to be maximally robust, strong, and self-enforcing, it must properly balance supply- and demand-side instruments. The results hold with homogeneous countries and are strengthened by heterogeneity.

Forward guidance and large-scale asset purchases were deployed forcefully and were then confronted by a rapid recovery and a sharp inflation surge. This paper synthesises the literature through that episode, focusing on the Federal Reserve. We revisit the background literature on forward guidance and asset purchases, focusing on issues that became central after 2020: state dependence, transmission under stress, and the design challenges that arise when conditions change unexpectedly. The episode yielded new transmission evidence—especially on asset purchases—but its main lessons concern policy design. The Fed’s 2020 policy package embedded too little flexibility once the outlook shifted, though likely with modest effects on inflation itself. More generally, unconventional policy faces a commitment–flexibility trade-off, suggesting that guidance conditions and purchase programmes should be stress tested across alternative states of the world before deployment.

title: Unconventional Monetary Policy: Lessons from 2020–2024
